results.resolution: Moved the ford, the leave-trail point and the Fortress-Chiwawa col onto the basin route where two independent GPS tracks and the terrain place them; removed the 6,300 ft bench pin (no two sources place it, and it sat 920 m off the line on 7,700 ft ground); corrected the itinerary's 8,200 ft col height to 7,200 ft.
results.summary: Three of the four misplaced Chiwawa Basin pins now sit where two separate GPS tracks (2017 and 2024) put the ford, the 5,500 ft basin and the 7,200 ft col; the high-camp bench pin could not be placed and is removed, and the itinerary's col height is fixed from 8,200 to 7,200 ft.
results.evidence: Two independent CalTopo GPS tracks of the basin route (map GBPH, a 2017 GPS track 'Fortress Mou #1'; map DKE28GP, a 2024 timed track 'CHIWAWA' by a different creator; only 36 of 2,845 vertices coincide, so not copies) both follow the row's drawn line (the row gpx matches GBPH to 3-20 m). FORD: both tracks cross the NHD Chiwawa River flowline at 48.1426,-120.8979 (GBPH 2 m, DKE 4 m), 150 m from the end of the USFS Chiwawa Basin trail #1550A (48.14396,-120.89833), and the 2024 track stops there for ~21 min; ground 4,771 ft (pin said 4,400 on ground 6,690 ft). LEAVE TRAIL / 5,500 ft BASIN: both tracks level out on the basin floor at ~5,470-5,500 ft and begin the steep climb at 48.15087,-120.91095 (GBPH 16 m; DKE 1,675 m elev = 5,496 ft); ground 5,534 ft (old pin on 7,850 ft ground, 1,455 m from the line). COL: the USGS 3DEP ground has a saddle at 48.1598,-120.9150 (7,217 ft; rises E toward Chiwawa and W toward Fortress, falls N and S); GBPH passes 20 m and DKE 4 m from it (DKE elev 2,195 m = 7,201 ft), and a 2020 trip report and a peak-list page give the Chiwawa-Fortress col as ~7,200 ft / 7,182 ft. Old col pin at 48.1646,-120.9033 was EAST of the summit on 8,037 ft ground. BENCH (6,300 ft): the tracks climb steadily through 6,300 ft at 48.1531,-120.9154 with no flat stretch or stop, and no source gives a position; old pin was 920 m off the line on 7,727 ft ground -> rule 1, removed. distMi of the three moved pins set null (ford said 5 mi though it lies beyond the 5.3 mi junction; no source gives trail mileage for them). Itinerary day 2 said the col is 'near 8,200 ft'; terrain and two sources put it at ~7,200 ft (the waypoint already says 7,200).

results.resolution: Moved pin 5 (south-side gully) from near the trailhead to the 6,800 ft point of the gully the route climbs, where two GPS recordings and an independent published route map agree.
results.summary: The gully pin sat 7 km south near the trailhead; it now sits in Argonaut's south gully at 6,800 ft, where two GPS tracks and a separate published route map put the climb.
results.evidence: Pin 5 was at 47.3991,-120.8826 (ground 4,200 ft vs stated 6,800), south of Ingalls Creek near the Beverly Turnpike trailhead. CalTopo map QBFRE holds two GPS recordings of the south route from different trips (2020-09-05 and 2022-07-23; the row's own gpx is the 2020 one). Both pass 6,800 ft at 47.4657,-120.8636 / 47.4660,-120.8636 in the gully climbing north toward the summit. An independent 2026 trip report reaches 'the broad South Gully at 6800 feet' and publishes a CalTopo route map; georeferencing that map on the camp and summit (3.1 m/px scale bar) puts its 6,800 ft point at about 47.4643,-120.8641, ~150 m from the tracks. USGS ground at 47.4657,-120.8636 is 6,865 ft. The name/note ('gully west of the main gully', 'loose rock') were not changed; the 2026 report calls the gully solid granite, which the owner may wish to reword.
